answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial, committing its identity through a Semaphore-backed RLN tree. Valid messages carry rate-limited shares tied to a hidden secret; duplicate use creates inconsistent shares, so Shamir secret sharing reconstructs the signing private key. The protocol verifies this evidence and instantly slashes collateral, making identities costly to clone, like a ripple across an oasis mirror.
